observations: Piray and Daw 2024 explicitly separate volatility from stochasticity because both raise variance but have opposite effects on autocorrelation; their process-level model jointly infers both online.

Piray 2026 CAUSE remains a Gaussian state-space preprint whose exploration bonus increases with volatility and decreases with stochasticity, making source reversal decision-relevant rather than merely a calibration error.

Robust Student-t state-space work provides a useful control principle: heavy-tailed observation noise and abrupt/process-side changes should be represented as distinct model families rather than collapsed into one Gaussian residual score.

bounded_audit.scope: Source-derived synthetic audit only. Not an exact reproduction of CAUSE, Piray-Daw 2024, SPLiT, or any author implementation. Four-arm restless Gaussian random-walk reward states were observed only on selected arms. Source hypotheses used v in {0.01,0.20}, s in {0.25,4.0}; semantic actions distinguished volatility-dominant (v=0.20,s=0.25) from stochasticity-dominant (v=0.01,s=4.0) states and otherwise fell back to shared/base parameters.

residual_family_checker.design: A fixed posterior-predictive residual family screen compared the Gaussian innovation likelihood against variance-one Student-t5, positive/negative standardized skew-normal, action-gap-adjusted AR(1) positive/negative correlation, and Gaussian scale alternatives. A time-gap-aware log Bayes-factor threshold was calibrated on disjoint matched-Gaussian random-action streams.
residual_family_checker.threshold_sweep_result: Lowering the residual BF threshold from 8.4 to 3.0 greatly increased abstention/out-of-family blocks but did not eliminate confident semantic reversals under correlated bursts; reversal fractions remained about 1.6-1.8% in the 40-seed threshold sweep. Therefore a fixed residual anomaly threshold is not a valid identifiability certificate.
residual_family_checker.interpretation: The source filter can absorb structured observation misspecification into its v/s posterior, partly normalizing the residuals that the external checker later inspects. Post-hoc residual surprise is therefore downstream of the same misspecified inference and can fail exactly when semantic source identity is wrong.

explicit_correlated_family.design: Replaced the post-hoc correlation test with an 8-hypothesis generative posterior: four (v,s) source states crossed with iid-observation rho=0 and correlated-observation rho=0.72 families. Each hypothesis used a 2D Kalman state [latent reward, correlated observation noise], so action gaps propagated the correlated observation-noise state explicitly. Source semantic posterior marginalized over observation family; source-specific CAUSE-style control was allowed only when semantic mass >=0.995 and posterior correlated-family mass <=0.95.
explicit_correlated_family.interpretation: Explicitly modeling correlated observation noise cut the confident semantic-reversal rate by about 46% relative (3.03% to 1.64%) under held-out correlated bursts, but did not meet the predeclared near-zero reversal requirement and did not produce a statistically resolved regret gain over shared/base. The previous small-seed zero-reversal result was not robust and is not promoted.

mechanistic_update.positive: Cause-aware control remains promising only when source identity is stable across plausible observation/process families. Explicit nuisance-family marginalization is materially safer than a post-hoc residual anomaly score.
mechanistic_update.negative_boundary: Posterior confidence inside one source family, or a scalar residual Bayes-factor threshold applied after source inference, is not an identifiability certificate. Even an explicit correlated-noise alternative left nonzero source reversals under burst misspecification.
mechanistic_update.new_design_hypothesis: Use a semantic-invariance gate rather than confidence alone: maintain explicit Gaussian, heavy-tail, skewed and correlated-burst observation families jointly with volatility/stochasticity source hypotheses, and allow source-specific control only when every model family carrying non-negligible posterior mass agrees on the semantic ordering. If plausible families disagree, use shared/base control. This directly tests whether the decision-relevant semantic claim is model-robust rather than merely high-posterior within one family.

limits: The broad Student-t/skew/AR/scale checker used fixed alternative shapes, not learned family parameters.
The explicit generative augmentation modeled only Gaussian iid versus Gaussian AR(1) observation noise; heavy tails, skew and burst-state transitions were not generatively marginalized.
Pseudo-regret and CAUSE-style source control are source-derived, not author-code reproduction.
Regret confidence intervals remain wide because policies diverge on restless random-walk trajectories; safety/reversal rates are the more stable finding in this run.
No genuine PAST/GROUSE or SPLiT execution occurred.
bounded_audit.exact_next_action: Continue read-only CAUSE author-code/independent-rerun and SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Replace the scalar residual checker with a joint model-robust semantic-invariance posterior: cross the four v/s source states with at least iid Gaussian, Student-t observation, skewed observation, and correlated/burst observation families; learn or marginalize the nuisance-family parameters online under action-dependent partial observations. Calibrate family priors and semantic-invariance threshold on disjoint families, then test held-out t3/heavier-tail, unseen skew magnitude, correlated bursts, Gaussian scale drift and mixtures. Compare forced MAP, source-only BMA, family-BMA, scalar-checker abstention, semantic-invariance abstention, always-shared/base, regime-only and oracle. Require statistically bounded near-zero confident semantic reversals across held-out misspecification and a resolved regret gain over shared/base in at least one predeclared regime before connecting to a genuine O(Nk) dormant-memory tracker. Preserve total abstention in label-symmetric/nonidentifiable regimes, exact tested scope, CLEAN isolation, and a nonempty frontier.
